boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Kenyon College
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe guide to Kenyon’s verified late dining option and evening food runs in Gambier and nearby Mount Vernon. Recheck hours before leaving, especially during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Late Night at Peirce
cards.subtitle: The on-campus option after regular dinner
cards.notes: Enter Peirce between 9 and 10:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday; confirm the academic calendar before relying on service.
cards.short_summary: Kenyon’s dining provider lists a dedicated weekday late-night service inside Peirce Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: AVI Fresh lists Peirce Dining Hall Late Night from 9:00 to 10:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Late Night is listed Monday–Thursday, 9:00–10:30 p.m.; campus dining schedules may change during breaks.

cards.title: A Nine-O’Clock Gambier Table
cards.subtitle: Dinner beside campus in Gambier village
cards.notes: Arrive before the 9 p.m. close and check the restaurant’s posted schedule first; evening service is unavailable Sunday and Monday.
cards.short_summary: This walkable village restaurant provides Gambier’s documented evening sit-down window.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village Inn lists dinner until 9:00 p.m. Tuesday through Friday and continuous service until 9:00 p.m. Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday 11 a.m.–2 p.m. and 5–9 p.m.; Saturday 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: The 1 A.M. Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Late carryout or delivery from Mount Vernon
cards.notes: Check the live store page, select carryout or delivery, and confirm that your Gambier address falls inside the current delivery area.
cards.short_summary: The Mount Vernon Domino’s publishes service extending into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page identifies the 406 Coshocton Avenue store and states that it is open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 406 Coshocton Ave. | Domino's in Mount Vernon
cards.access_notes: The official store page reports service until 1:00 a.m.; delivery range and daily hours should be confirmed when ordering.

cards.title: Friday Pizza After Ten
cards.subtitle: Weekend carryout or delivery in Mount Vernon
cards.notes: Use the location page to choose carryout or delivery, noting that dine-in closes earlier than the Friday and Saturday order window.
cards.short_summary: This South Main Street shop keeps its documented delivery and carryout window later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday at 700 South Main Street.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut: Pizza & Wings - Delivery & Take Out From 700 S Main
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout run until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. other nights; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: South Main Until One
cards.subtitle: An all-week Mount Vernon drive-thru option
cards.notes: Plan this as a vehicle run from Gambier and verify the location page before departure; both restaurant and drive-thru list the same close.
cards.short_summary: The South Main Wendy’s maintains a documented 1 a.m. closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 6:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m. daily at 522 South Main Street.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 522 South Main Street in Mount Vernon, OH
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1:00 a.m. seven days a week.

cards.title: Coshocton Avenue Until Two
cards.subtitle: The latest verified Wendy’s window nearby
cards.notes: Use the Coshocton Avenue address when navigating; Mount Vernon has another Wendy’s with a different, earlier closing time.
cards.short_summary: This specific Wendy’s location documents food service through 2 a.m. every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m. daily at 994 Coshocton Avenue.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 994 Coshocton Avenue in Mount Vernon, OH
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 2:00 a.m. seven days a week.

cards.title: Newark Road After Midnight
cards.subtitle: A late drive-thru south of downtown Mount Vernon
cards.notes: Expect drive-thru service late at night and verify the day’s dine-in listing separately; the published access windows are not identical.
cards.short_summary: The Newark Road Taco Bell documents drive-thru service beyond midnight all week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 2:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Mount Vernon, OH — 120 Newark Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; late dine-in availability is more limited.

cards.title: The Other Two-A.M. Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: Late drive-thru on Mount Vernon’s east side
cards.notes: Navigate to 1015 Coshocton Avenue, not Newark Road, and treat late service as drive-thru unless the official page confirms dine-in.
cards.short_summary: Mount Vernon’s Coshocton Avenue Taco Bell also carries a verified post-midnight schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru until 1:00 a.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 2:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me in Mount Vernon, OH
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; the listed dine-in window ends earlier.

cards.title: Midnight on Coshocton Avenue
cards.subtitle: Drive-thru service every night in Mount Vernon
cards.notes: Choose drive-thru for the latest window; the lobby closes at 10 p.m., so confirm the address and order channel before leaving Gambier.
cards.short_summary: This McDonald’s pairs a 10 p.m. lobby close with later drive-thru access.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists drive-thru service until midnight Sunday through Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Mount Vernon, OH at 1059 Coshocton Ave | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Lobby closes at 10 p.m.; drive-thru closes at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Weekend Midnight on Sandusky Street
cards.subtitle: A Friday-and-Saturday Mount Vernon drive-thru
cards.notes: Reserve this run for the verified late-week window and check the official schedule first; other days close earlier or vary sharply.
cards.short_summary: The Sandusky Street McDonald’s extends its drive-thru to midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists drive-thru service until midnight Friday and Saturday at 674 Sandusky Street.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Mount Vernon, OH at 674 Sandusky Street | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at midnight Friday–Saturday; other days have earlier or irregular posted closing times.

warnings: Eight cards require travel from Gambier to Mount Vernon; confirm safe transportation before departure.
Published hours can change for holidays, academic breaks, weather, staffing, or individual order channels; recheck the linked direct source.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because they were not independently verified from authoritative direct pages.
